title: Mixed representative normalization of the pro-etale projection mate
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y and an identified pullback of coefficient ring sheaves, use the ordinary and derived operations of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the normalized tensor comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and the mixed representative isomorphisms of [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows]. For a K-injective complex I on X and a flat-term K-flat coefficient complex F on Y, the derived projection mate, precomposed with tensor of the right-derived unit at I and postcomposed with direct image of the mixed tensor comparison on X, equals the mixed comparison on Y followed by localization of the ordinary signed total counit mate and the right-derived unit at Tot(I⊗f*F). No boundedness or degreewise splitting of F is assumed.

source.place: equation-projection-formula-map; lemma-pullback-tensor-product; lemma-adjoint. Blueprint order 1267, representative calculation in proof step 5.

proof.text: Choose a flat K-flat resolution P of the ordinary direct image of I. The unique mixed-tensor representative square computes its localized source comparison. Its naturality follows by applying a functorial flat resolution to a chain map and using representative naturality.

Use the canonical tensor-pullback representative square on P and F. Naturality of the mixed comparison on X identifies the composite with the tensor of pullback of P-to-VI followed by the ordinary counit, and the identity of the pulled-back F. The derived counit representative normalization is Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app.

Transpose under the derived adjunction. Naturality of the total tensor pullback and the ordinary adjunction identify this transpose with localization of tensorAdjunctionTotal followed by the right-derived unit. Cancel tensor of the localized resolution, which is invertible. This proves the equation without boundedness, splitting, or inverse projection maps.

proof_origin.place: The definition of the projection formula as the adjoint of counit tensor identity, calculated on K-flat representatives.

theorem proEtaleMixedProjectionMate
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R) (b : ProEtaleTensorModel X S)
    (I : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X S) ℤ) (_hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (F : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ)
    (hF : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R F) :
    let L := proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c
    let V := proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f R S c
    let G := (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F
    let J := CochainComplex.mapBifunctor I G (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X S)
    let hG := (proEtaleCanonicalTensorPullback f R S c a b).1 F hF
    let eta (C : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X S) ℤ) :
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((V.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ⟶
          (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) :=
      V.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj C)
    a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (eta I) (𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 2}.obj F))) ≫
        proEtaleProjectionFormulaMate f R S c a b
          (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 2}.obj I) (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 2}.obj F) ≫
        (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c).map
          (b.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 2}.obj I))
            ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R S c).hom.app F)) ≫
              (proEtaleMixedTensor S b I G hG).hom) =
      (proEtaleMixedTensor R a
        ((V.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) F hF).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 2}.map (proEtaleProjectionTotal f R S c I F) ≫ eta J
